statements.text: President Trump announced a reciprocal energy ceasefire.
The UK has announced new funding to help Ukraine through its fifth winter under Russian bombardment.
The UK is delivering £45 million of surface-to-air missiles to Ukraine, and has committed £1.6 billion to deliver more than 5000 Lightweight Multirole Missiles over four years.
A new UK sanctions package now covers over 90% of Russia's oil producing capacity.
The UK is standing by plans to fully implement a maritime services ban on Russian LNG exports.
Britain has decided to send air defence and a Voyager aircraft to Saudi Arabia.
The Voyager aircraft sent to Saudi Arabia has completed 14 operational missions.
Andy Burnham and Chancellor Merz agreed a new partnership in Berlin to tackle hybrid threats.
The Prime Minister set out the UK's latest package of Lightweight Multirole Missiles.

Construction of the Great British Railways headquarters at Becketwell, a brownfield site in Derby city centre, is expected to begin in early 2027 and be completed by spring 2029. The site will accommodate up to 450 staff.
Up to 600 apprentices aged 16 to 21 will enrol over the next four years on the rail foundation apprenticeship, with the first starters based in Derby.

Andy Burnham made an offer to the Scottish Government, calling on it to work with the UK Government through No10 North and the Scotland Office to develop a new model of regional empowerment for Scotland.
